releases.name: v2.6.3
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added free Roblox Plus themes, allowing you to enable Roblox Plus themes without Roblox Plus
- Added an indicator if an item is hidden from the marketplace
- Added FAE (facial age estimation) icon to item cards of items requiring FAE to buy.
- Added a feature showing who on your friends list owns an item
- Added accepting robux on the buy page cause that exists!, thanks to @auggeeo for making it
- Added customizable background image, thanks to @IYoLsa for making it
- Added decal support for showcases, to showcase art!

Changes:
- Made under 16 able to donate via a the game if they get parental permission, thanks to @auggeeo for making it.
- Removed the theme switcher since it was too buggy
- Removed download button hider as Roblox removed it themself, thanks to @nxvixz
- Fixed badge text being offset upwards, thanks to @bogdan-glitchm for fixing it
- Fixed thumbnails sometimes not displaying the broken icon for images that doesnt work
- Fixed categorize wearing not being able to categorize hidden items
- Fixed RoValra containers not having proper support for stuff like themes
- Fixed categorized wearing failing to put animations in its own category in some cases
- Fixed categorized wearing sometimes not showing an item a user is wearing
- Attempted to fix showcases sometimes not showing showcased items
- Changed Most Frequent Played Together to be off by default.

releases.name: v2.6.2
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added Improved Avatar Card which adds a gap around your avatar card on your profile, making it look a bit more modern and nice.
- Added a site fix to keep profile usernames spaced from the top to prevent them from being in a spot where its harder to read.
- Added support for backgrounds to categorize wearing, and made it a bit better in general
- Added customizable Roblox banner (off by default) thanks to @IYoLsa for making it.
- Added Favourite experience and Favourite community show case to your profile, so you can show off your Favourite experience and community

Changes:
- Disabled sound item in the renderer (such a rich people problem :sob: you know who you are LOL)
- Added 3px of margin top to the Profile Views pill
- Fixed a rare bug where rovalra would force a user to be in light mode
- Fixed RoValra spamming requests way more than it should

releases.name: v2.6.1
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added much more support for theme switcher.
- Added a setting to hide the Add Friends button on Home page, thanks @IYoLsa for making it
- Added allow joining button for private server list, thanks to @goingcrazydude for making it
- Added customizable Topbar Layout editor (off by default), thanks to @IYoLsa for making it

Changes:
- Added support to the new Roblox Profile to profile gradients.
- Made username color preview color the username instead of display name, thanks to @moowi1337 for making it
- Made RoValra not retry when APIs fail.
- Fixed when sidebar collapsed communities list doesnt change position, thanks to @gaxolotl for fixing it.

releases.name: v2.6
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added customizable side bar, thanks to @radwl for making it
- Added server list support to private / moderated game viewer
- Added wide game title player count stats, thanks to @radwl for making it
- Added forced admin badge, so the admin badge shows on admins profiles even if they don't have it.
- Added the ability to send Robux Via Roblox Plus directly on the site, thanks to @auggeeo for making it
- Added continue updating without refreshing the site (off by default) thanks to @rav4toy for making it.
- Added trusted friend support to QoL toggles
- Moved Roblox Plus related features to a new "Roblox Plus" tab in settings, thanks to @auggeeo for doing it.
- Added support for bundles to the explorer, thanks to  @moowi1337 for making it.
- Added 2d clothing support to dependencies cuz of Robloxs recent "safety update" to prevent stealing.
- Added download as .obj for meshes on the create page
- Added site fix making the search bar scale down if theres too much on the right side
- Added pronouns to profiles, thanks to @rav4toy for making it.
- Added private notes to profiles, thanks to @rav4toy for making it.

Changes:
- Made item render on by default
- Made shop show Robux packages even if there isn't a bonus item
- Made custom name colors that blend into the background be automatically lighten up so its easier to read
- Made the item renderer lighting 1.5x brighter to make it less dark (WHAT REALLY?)
- Made the settings page load without needing to wait for RoValra api requests to be done
- Fixed name gradient being on by default (silly mistake :sob:)
- Fixed Roblox Plus Transfer limits using hard coded numbers instead of fetching the transfer limits for the user.
- Fixed Private Games sometimes doing a loop where it went back to games then went back to private-games repeat.
- Fixed explorer assetdelivery requests failing due to CORS, thanks to @steinann for fixing it
- Fixed quick play visual issue related to wide game cards, thanks to @radwl for fixing it
- Fixed issues related to dropdown
- Fixed tooltip zindex issues
- Fixed fiat estimates adding the estimate to credits and robux.
- Fixed an incompatibility with RoPro and RoValra making the website crash if viewing your own profile
- Fixed Roblox plus sidebar thingy was not centered when sidebar was collapsed, thanks to @gaxolotl for fixing it

releases.name: v2.5.10.1
releases.body:
hot fix:
- Finished channel tracking related stuff, as it was not meant to be in v2.5.10.

releases.name: v2.5.10
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added combine community funds with navbar balance, thanks to @elDziad00 for making it.

Changes:
- Heavily improved performance of the extension in rare cases where performance would be awful, big thanks to everyone who helped debug this issue <3
- Attempted to fix a crash related to the profile Customization feature.

releases.name: v2.5.9.1
releases.body:
Hot fix:
- Fixed the private games not working

releases.name: v2.5.9
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added a stars program badge for people in the stars program and for a custom badge for people in the Roblox community feedback program + more
- Added previous Beta programs, showing what beta programs you were previously enrolled into.
- Added 2 new donator perks for tier 3 donators. Display Name effect, and Display Name Gradient.
- Added roblox plus currency transfer limits to the site, which shows how close u are to hitting the limits
- Added feature clickable friend currently playing card, thanks to @radwl for making it


Changes:
- Fixed Private / Moderated game viewers breaking after a Roblox update.
- Fixed shop getting the same gamepasses on a loop
- Fixed streamer mode breaking ad manager, thanks to @auggeeo
- Fixed home layout allowing you to adjust things that wasnt visible.
- Fixed RoValra off centering the friend tooltip
- Improved stuff, thanks to @auggeeo
- Improved Donator page, thanks to @auggeeo
- Improved theme editor quite a bit
- Improved trading with a bunch of under the hood changes, for more stability

releases.name: v2.5.8.1
releases.body:
Hot Fix
- Fixed issues with avatar border store.

releases.name: v2.5.8
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added a new customization tab that allows you to view owned and unowned borders and equip and unequip them from your profile
- Added dim unowned game badges, Thanks to @Kanibal02 for making it
- Added a changelogs tab to settings, so you can easily see what changed in each version.

Changes:
- Improve credits contributor list, thanks to @Kanibal02 for making it
- Fixed RoValra not hiding server ids of servers you or friends are in.
- Fixed misc under the hood issues.
- Fixed cosmetics sometimes not showing the right thing for the specific person, especially noticeable on friends page
- Removed "Credits" and made it only for contributors, since credits were insanely old and outdated.

releases.name: v2.5.7.1
releases.body:
Changes:
- Fixed manifest permissions being updated, this was not meant to end up in a final release.

releases.name: v2.5.7
releases.body:
new stuff:
- Added donator pop up to remind people that they can donate to help support RoValra.
- Added v2 and v1 gamejoin support

Changes
- Improved the donator page a bit.

releases.name: v2.5.6
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Changed RoValras logo, while keeping a setting to bring the old one back
- Added a setting to disable item hover preview for item renderer
- Added can chat or not or if they havent done an age check tooltip to friends profile
- Added Explorer that allows you to view items and editable experiences as if they were in studio. Thanks to @moowi1337 for making it + GUI render support, thanks to @Pedro-Brito-09 for making it.
- Added all ages review status to games, showing if they are currently reviewing to be playable by all ages
- Added a setting to hide the RoValra settings button from the settings dropdown.
- Added age badge customization and add new select theme. Thanks to @auggeeo  for making it.
- Added Roblox stats to plus page when unsubscribed. Thanks to @auggeeo for making it.
- Added View the Subplace someone is playing (off by default), thanks to @rav4toy for making it.
- Added looks support to the item renderer  thanks to @steinann for adding it
- Added custom site themes, thanks to @cornusandu for making it. (beta and off by default)
- Added bonus item selector (Currently in beta and disabled by default)
- Added a docs feature, for a documentation on undocumented Roblox APIs.
- Added a new shop feature, which adds the in game shop directly to the site
- Added fallback sale from clothing for not age checked or under 16 so they can still buy donator perks
- Readded the adding of trusted friends on the after Roblox seemingly removed it.

Changes:
- Improved events, making it show an interactive timestamp for upcoming events
- Improved quick search.
- Moved Id verification badge to the more tab on a profile to prevent clutter.
- Made fun stuff tab not show by default
- Made cosmetics show in more spots
- Made account standing only show if a user had some kind of action taken against them
- Added a message saying 500 internal errors are Robloxs fault for total spent and total earned
- Optimized RoValra store page
- Fixed Access code for private server is not valid thanks to @Zed128 for fixing it
- Fixed issues with less Roblox Plus, thanks to @cornusandu for fixing it
- Fixed statuses not supporting different lines in some places
- Fixed render issues, thanks to @steinann for fixing it
- Reduced RoValra load times by 80%, aka improved the performance.

releases.name: v2.5.5
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added hidden badges, making u able to view hidden badges on games that you previously obtained
- Added grid toggle to badges, allowing you to change the badge layout to a grid.
- Added chat color to display names, which makes a users display name on their profile match their chat color in game (off by default) Thanks to @nxvixz for making it.
- Added Remove Download Button from the nav bar (off by default), thanks to @nxvixz for making it.
- Added home layout changes, allowing you to modify the home page layout.
- Added underrated games, that works kinda like standout games but for underrated games hand picked by the RoValra community.
- Added last on sale to previous price, which shows when the item was last on sale
- Added last equipped, showing when u last equipped an item on the item page.
- Added bulk group leave, allowing you to leave groups in bulk, thanks to @moowi1337 for making it.
- Added Render Options to item renderer, allowing you to toggle a baseplate environment and toggle dark lighting to easily see the emissive textures.
- Added clickable currently playing cards, making the currently playing card on users profile link to the game.
- Added remote feature disabler, allowing us to disable RoValra features globally without updating the extension, in case something breaks.

Changes:
- Changed "most played together" to "Most Frequent Played Together" to be more accurately worded.
- Fixed fiat issues with total spent.
- Fixed Improved currently wearing not displaying the sales price of limited gears
- Fixed auth games staying failing to be unfavorited.
- Fixed fiat displaying the wrong amount in specific places.
- Fixed price floor icon not being aligned properly with Roblox Plus
- Fixed renderer issue with new Roblox bundles, thanks to @steinann for fixing it
- Fixed the wrong price being shown on very specific items
- Fixed roseal incompatibility with parent item
- Fixed site content not moving over when side bar is hidden by Roblox
- Somewhat fixed effects showing a black background on the profile renderer
- Attempted to fix issues with preferred region fallback.
- Attempted to improve accuracy of total spent.
- Removed premium subscription breakdown from total spent.
- Added more transactions types to total earned and total spent.
- Added more tos reminders to status
- Added rotate button for the item preview in item renderer
- Added banner to gamepass viewer explaining that its a RoValra feature
- Made the ui of total earned and total spent show what they scanned more clearly
- Made top donators show a users verified badge if they have one.
- Disabled group role feature since roblox released their own version of it.
- Updated the info on the settings page to be more up to date.
- Improved accurate continue playing

releases.name: v2.5.4
releases.body:
new stuff:
- Added a setting showing what settings changed in an update (off by default), thanks to @cornusandu for making it
- Avatar download button, allowing you to download an avatar png (off by default), thanks to @moowi1337 for making it
- Added Profile views, showing the total views from RoValra users on a profile.
- Added a confirmation prompt for experimental, beta and deprecated features letting a user know they might cause issues.
- Added gamepass viewer, which allows you to view gamepass pages of private or deleted games, thanks to @moowi1337 for making it
- Added Collapsible Sidebar allowing you to make the sidebar smaller.

Changes
- Fixed a few issues with item renderer
- Fixed item renderer not replacing buttons properly
- Fixed on going events saying "Notify me" instead of changing it to a "join event" button
- Fixed avatar borders not always being animated on users profile
- Fixed avatar borders playing in the background, which used more resources
- Fixed quick search waiting for presence
- Fixed streamer mode not hiding email, thanks to @aliceenight for making it.
- Fixed social links on private games showing for users who arent age checked.
- Attempted to fix RoValra making load times on profiles longer.
- Made improved currently wearing support gears
- Improved performance a lot, thanks to @steinann for finding it
- Improved cosmetic related features.
- Added support for rolimons bundle links
- Changed instant joiner to be off by default.

releases.name: v2.5.3
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added an option to select between the different Roblox themes, Roblox kids, Roblox select and normal Roblox

Changes:
-  Fixed total robux donated and leaderboard annoymous mode
- Added missing r6 jump animation to item render

releases.name: v2.5.2
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added R6 / R15 toggle to item renderer
- Added Total donated, shows how much you donated to RoValra

Changes:
- Fixed spa navigation in item renderer.
- Fixed tou agreement showing where it isnt meant to
- Fixed avatar borders showing locally but not server side
- Fixed RoValra trying to request with user id "null"
- Fixed parts of a users profile flickering

releases.name: v2.5.1
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Avatar borders, this allows you to select a avatar border thats visible to all RoValra users (Donator tier 3 perk), thanks to @aliceenight for making it.
- Social links support on deleted / private games
- Moderated date on deleted games.
- Item 3d preview and improved 3d item rendering (off by default as experimental), thanks to @steinann for making it.
- Scam prevention, adds a banner to the login page when on the real Roblox site so you know its the real site. (off by default)
- Less Roblox Plus, this reduces or fully removes all roblox plus advertisements on the site, thanks to @cornusandu for making it.
- Community filters on profiles, allows you to filter by newest joined, oldest joined, a-z z-a on anyones profile.
- Join date on communities, on a users profile it shows when they joined a specific community

Changes:
- Improved the paid games pill, making it show on the thumbnail now and only checking games in view.
- Fixed download button not being added to the create page. https://github.com/NotValra/RoValra/issues/76
- Fixed user.js overwriting authed user with null if it failed to get a user id
- Fixed private games sometimes failing to display gamepasses.
- Fixed private games not displaying maturity rating of deleted games.
- Fixed Private games sometimes doing an inf redirect loop.
- Fixed tooltips not working on private games.
- Fixed and attempted to fix multiple issues related to preferred region
- Fixed recent servers displaying inactive servers as active
- Fixed improved events thumbnail sizes sometimes being wrong.
- Fixed event category not being displayed properly
- Fixed RoValra displaying the wrong deletion reason for very specific deleted games.
- Made RoValra automatically fixed corrupted saved data to prevent issues.
- Made status and gradients show in more places.
- Made the third time setting in rovalra display what the tooltip displays and the second one displays in order based off pc settings.
- Made all RoValra requests require access tokens.
- Improved the loading of top donator leaderboard, and contributors.
- Avatar preview for settings like gradient and avatar borders.
- ToU pop up when setting a status so a user knows what they can or cannot do.

releases.name: v2.5
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Made status and environments saved via RoValra API free for everyone, with replacement donator 1 perks coming soon.
- Improved Events, this feature allows you to see past events on games and how many signed up for the event.
- Show Community Roles, Shows a users role in a community on their profile.
- Total Community Visits, Shows the total Visits across A communities game
- Group created date.
- Currency Transfer on Profiles. Allowing Roblox Plus subscribers to easily transfer currency to anyone.
- Modern Icons, switches the old playing and like icons out with the new icons used by the client
- Paid game prices to item cards, thanks to @rav4toy for making it
- More toggles in QoL toggles, thanks to @Zed128 for making it.
- Roblox Plus Free Server Tooltip, shows the price of private servers if you have plus, thanks to @Kanibal02 for making it
- Accurate continue, changes your continue to be accurate based off the the order you played them (off by default)
- More thumbnail support on private / moderated games.
- Contributors on settings, pretty much shows who contributed to each setting / feature.
- Basic markdown support on statuses, thanks to @cornusandu for making it.
- Added a missing friended source
- Added a moderation system, meaning if you are caught doing not okay stuff some server side features may be revoked.
- Made serverlist uptime show seconds and update the time live.
- Made Private / moderated games load instantly

Changes:
- Added support for the new reworked server list Roblox is releasing.
- Added support for values on bundles on the trading ui.
- Fixed the globe failing to display some regions.
- Fixed total spent showing the wrong amount
- Fixed No gamepasses text showing on the dev products tab, thanks to @rav4toy for fixing it
- Fixed Trading info on item pages not supporting spa navigation
- Fixed dependencies not working on some items, thanks to for @aliceenight fixing it.
- Fixed odd styling on the instant join after a Roblox update.
- Fixed delta time being slightly off in the avatar renderer.
- Fixed an issue where the site would crash if using RoValra, with specific other extensions while having specific features enabled.
- Fixed 40% method not working with specific languages.
- Fixed banned users failing to display deleted games on their profile.
- Fixed RoValra made gamecards not having a like icon if they didnt have a like ratio.
- Fixed private games not redirecting to the game page if the game isnt private or deleted.
- Fixed 40% method adding save robux on limiteds.
- Improved performance of the extension in some niche spots.
- Improved fiat a lot, making it less buggy
- Improved hidden games loading times (still needs some improvements)
- Improved "What am i joining" making it more consistent with the rest of the uptime displaying ui by making it update uptime live, and making it display if its 100% accurate or not.
- Made Private Games on by default and made it not require webRequest permissions
- Made Banned User on by default and made it not require webRequest permissions
- Made preferred region show if the gamejoin api is erroring with the error message, so a user knows why its happening + developer settings to simulate it.
- Made RoValra load faster.
- Did a bunch of changes to server list related features to improve them.
- Removed the setting to disable status video audio, since audio is disabled by default now.
- One time migration that migrates your description status and environment to the rovalra api.
- Added Roblox-Bat which is a more secure way of sending Roblox requests. [Read more about how it works here](https://www.npmjs.com/package/roblox-bat)

releases.name: v2.4.15
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Most played Together, show what game you played the most with a user on their profile
- Total Spent Per Game, shows how much you spent under each game
- Robux Fiat Estimates, shows a money estimate beside Robux Values, Thanks to @tigodev1 for making it.
- Legacy Theme Switcher, adds a theme selector that works like the old theme selector, Thanks to @lolct for making it.
- Last seen / last online, showing when a user on your friends list was last online
- Added Subgenre to Private / moderated games
- Added a tooltip to private / moderated games showing the full amount of Visits, Active, Favorites and Max Players
- Added functionality to the "friends playing" icon on RoValra created game cards, as RoValra gamecards sometimes replaces Robloxs
- Added missing friends from sources, thanks to roseal.
- Added Version text to the Subplace game cards.
- Added more settings to trading related features for better extension compatibility 
- Improved the update heatmap, adding date range filters and smaller QoL tweaks.

Changes:
- Made the status input show how the status will look more properly
- Made the status show instantly on stuff like home pages when hovering
- Changed friends since and friends source to only show when viewing your own friends list.
- Changed the background color of Profile buttons to be none transparent if a user has an environment or gradient enabled for readability.
- Changed the max width of status to be smaller.
- Fixed Voice chat supported showing unsupported when voice chat is supported
- Fixed Private / moderated games breaking if a user doesnt have their language set to english
- Fixed trading features sometimes showing the wrong difference
- Fixed misc bugs related to Quick Search
- Fixed styling issues related to the the include Robux toggle when trading
- Attempted to fix an issue where  preffered region fallback location were not checked for inactively before allowing a user to join it.

releases.name: v2.4.14
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added a proper environment creator for the 3d profile renderer. Allowing you to create your own custom client sided environment in prep for community made environments
- Added profile gradient, allowing you to make a gradient for your profile background. (Donator perk tier 2)
- Added a Donator leaderboard that shows the top 10 donators.

Changes:
- Reduced the amount of requests status sends by caching the response locally.
- Improved unpending tomorrow, thanks to @Kanibal02
- Heavily reworked a lot of logic in the 10%-40% method feature, in an attempt to make it more consistent and stable.
- Fixed bulk unfriend not working without RoSeal.
- Fixed bulk unfriend showing the display name instead of username.
- Fixed friend since and friends from causing styling issues.
- Fixed banned games displaying the wrong reason why a game is unavailable if content deleted.
- Fixed banned games assuming the creator is a user.
- Fixed broken icons not having none square ratio support.
- Fixed the 40% method not displaying if a creator disabled purchasing in experiences.
- Fixed group icons on profiles overflowing
- Fixed Transactions being added to other  parts of the site than just the side bar
- Fixed issues where api requests that should not be cached locally were cached locally
- Fixed private / moderated experience viewer sometimes showing the wrong create and update date

releases.name: v2.4.13
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added sticky avatar preview, thanks to @zoinbase for making it.
- Added banned user profiles, allowing you to view banned user profiles  (off by default)
- Added Private and moderated experience viewer (off by default)
- Added custom font for the Roblox site, thanks to @aliceenight for making it
- Added a new fallback auth so people who cannot use Robloxs oauth is still able to have donator perks
- Added Bulk Friend removal.
- Added a feature showing where a user added you from. e.g in game, profile search etc.
- Added a site fix for Robloxs new very poorly made Favorites carousel, pretty much made it look how it should :D
- Added my transactions to side bar, thanks to @tigodev1 for making it
- Made RoValra generate a Roblox API key automatically allowing RoValra to use more APIs. The api key is only used locally.
- Made status max characters 128 instead of 50

Changes:
- Improved the compiling / building process of the extension, thanks to @tigodev1 for improving it
- Improved Region Selector, making it join new servers to make it have a higher likely hood of joining fuller servers.
- Improved styling and other small improvements for consistency in trading related features.
- Improved the donator page in settings.
- Improved caching logic, thanks to @cornusandu for improving it.
- Improved multiple scripts storage / caching logic to future proof them
- Improved the rap.js styling
- Fixed hidden profile experiences link sometimes not working cuz I did a little mistake
- Fixed skin tones not being applied in some cases when using quick outfits and avatar rotator
- Fixed 40% method save robux button not having proper light mode support.
- Fixed improved currently wearing displaying deleted items as "not found"
- Fixed improved currently wearing displaying "limiteds" as "limitedU"
- Fixed server list filters considered full servers as inactive.
- Fixed search history duplicating when using spa navigation
- Fixed hidden community experiences duplicating when using spa navigation
- Fixed group funds duplicating when using spa navigation
- Fixed issue with Robloxs new side bar, thanks to @aliceenight for making it
- Fixed rovalra apis not returning a new accessToken when the old one expired.
- Fixed copy id showing outside of Roblox
- Fixed RoValra not saying if servers in a region went inactive.
- Attempted to fix an issue where the 10%-40% method displayed the wrong saved robux amount
- Made any part of rovalra that generate user thumbnails able to generate banned users thumbnail
- Disabled experience trailer feature.

releases.name: v2.4.12.5
releases.body:
# **Hot fix**

- Fixed status not being applied if you aren't a donator
- Fixed environment not being applied if you aren't a donator.

releases.name: v2.4.12
releases.body:
new stuff:
- Added a new donator perk for all tiers, allowing donators to set status and environments without adding it in their about me.
- Added values to trades showing how much you are winning in value and rap and demand.
- Added a risk calulator that shows how risky an item is (experimental and off by default)
- Added a trade preview allowing you to see how much you are winning or losing in a trade without clicking on it.
- Added icons for rares and projected on the trade page.
- Added a small preview of the trade on the confirmation page so you dont accidentally send the wrong trade.
- Made the time sent more readable on the trades.
- Updated rap on users profile to support values, projected and rare marking too.
- Added a trade filter allowing you to search for items in your completed, inbound, outbound or inactive trades.
- Added values, demand, trend, projected, rare, and risk to item pages. 
- Added Proof Trades allowing you to quickly copy a trade proof for a given trade so you can easily proof it in rolimons
- Added "locked" features to the setting page, in case features becomes broken to where they have to be disabled.
- Made a bunch of improvements to the settings page.

Changes:
- Improved Profile Renderer reworks performance
- Moved friend tracking requests used for features like "friended since" to background.js to make it more stable and to not flood the network tab
- Improved status spoofing.
- Made 3d renderer rework forcefully enable 3d renderer on profile to prevent confusion.
- Fixed RoValra not checking if servers are active locally.
- Lowered the amount of gamejoin api requests cuz of roblox changing rate limits
- Added support for full masks in pricefloor.

releases.name: v2.4.11
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added profile 3d render, allowing for effect items, animations and way more cool stuff thanks to RoAvatar (off by default as experimental for now)
- Added custom environments to 3d avatar renders on profiles
- Added developer settings making it a lot easier to make environments
- Added status bubble that shows on your profile where u can set a custom status for anyone with RoValra to see.
- Added group funds in the nav bar, showing your group funds and pending group funds.
- Added locale support in RoValra, which will be community driven translations to make sure it is as accurate as possible. (Not entirely done)
- Added better credits to the people who contributed to RoValra
- Added a feature that shows if a user is ID verified on Roblox or not.
- Added more functionality to the beta programs navigation bar selector, now showing if the beta program is in an allowlist, and the platforms its on.
- Added a "friends Since" feature thats shows you how long you have been friends with a user
- Added "Robux After Purchase" feature, which pretty much brings back the "Your balance after this transaction will be x" to the new Roblox Purchase UI

Changes
- Renamed all mentions of "connections" to "friends"
- Added 40% method support to Robloxs new purchase ui.
- Fixed settings separator for descriptions showing when a setting doesnt have a description
- Fixed improved currently wearing not showing any items for other categories if the user doesnt have any items in the items category.
- Fixed gamepasses not having the "save x amount" button added for the 10%-40% method
- Fixed preferred region falling back to manually scanning fallback, if all the servers in the closest region has been joined before. It now correctly checks the second closest and third closest etc with the rovalra api until it finds a server.
- Fixed subplaces not having a load more button.
- Fixed a bug where RoValra badges could be removed right after being added to the site.

releases.name: v2.4.10
releases.body:
New stuff:
- Added developer products to the store tab on experiences.
- Added Update History feature showing a heatmap of a games update history heavily inspired by RoPro v2s update history (Beta but on by default)
- Added a feature showing the previous price of off sale items in currently wearing.
- Added a feature that completely redesigns robloxs currently wearing ui, heavily inspired by RoSeals improved currently wearing.
- Added a feature showing what bundle an item is from when viewing items that are in bundles on the catalog.
- Added a feature that autocompletes searches for games, users and friends
- Added a feature that shows your search history when using robloxs search feature.
- Added a feature showing if Roblox thinks your account is the first account you ever created.
- Added a feature allowing you to add, remove and accept trusted connections on the site.

Changes:
- Reworked the outfits ui a bit making it a lot better.
- made it clearer when you don't have permissions to manage games when using the 40% method.
- made only one dropdown able to be able to show at a time.
- made a clear selected for the avatar rotator
- made a "Open Setup" button in the settings page for the 40% method so its easier to configure.
- made an option in the group dropdown in the 40% method for if you don't have a group, explaining how to set it up.
- Fixed an issue with the dropdown ui where the arrow could get stuck in the pointing up position after selecting an option.
- Fixed right click copy id not supporting developer products.
- Fixed outfits viewers links being incorrect on assets inside of bundles.
- Fixed a bug where hidden games on user profiles would get stuck loading for a very long time.
- Fixed avatar rotator showing the same avatars when pressing load more (Roblox is never consistent)
- Fixed subplaces getting subplaces without a user being on the tab.
- Fixed download button not being added cuz roblox changed the element for no reason YAY
- Fixed avatar rotator overlaying the create button.
- Fixed save x robux being added to limited items.
- Fixed placeholder text in input boxes overlaying the value in the input box in settings.
- Fixed server list filters not showing player count and correct thumbnails when the data is there.
- Fixed uses of old names of things like experiences in settings
- Improved the items.js script a bit.
- Attempted to improve avatar rotators consistency

releases.name: v2.4.9
releases.body:
New Stuff:
- Added quick copy id in the right click context menu (off by default)
- Added quick copy universe id in the right click context menu (off by default)
- Added a toggle for optional permissions in settings, so u can disable them if you dont want them enabled at a later date
- Added a feature making equipping multiple accessories seamless.
- Added a beta programs toggle to the nav bar (off by default)
- Added a new category in settings for Navigation related features
- Added a [test page](https://www.roblox.com/test) used for testing ui related things in rovalra.
- Added donator perks to the settings page showing what you get for donating.
- Made streamer mode hide previous usernames in settings.

Changes:
- Fixed a bug where quality of life toggles would allow for an inf horizontal scroll.
- Fixed out of sync setting.
- Fixed RoValra getting recent servers in the background even when recent servers is disabled.
- Fixed recent servers flooding the networks tab with presence api requests, sorry to anyone trying to develop stuff.
- Fixed view user outfits button being incompatible with some extensions.
- Fixed view user outfits styling issues thats been bugging me for a while.
- Fixed Avatar rotator not displaying all avatars
- Fixed the 40% method not adding save x robux to cart if opening the cart on the main catalog page
- Fixed RoValra not verifying that the fallback server is actually active when using preferred region.
- Fixed odd spacing on the quality of life toggles.
- Attempted to fix an issue where the custom roblox launch ui could crash your browser if left running in the background for too long.
- Changed the slider color in settings to match robloxs slider.
- Updated the view user outfits ui to match the ui of the rest of the extension
- Updated background.js heavily making it a lot easier to work with.
- Reworked the way RoValra creates game cards and item cards, to be easier to work with and a lot better in general.

releases.name: v2.4.8
releases.body:
With this update the legacy donator badge is officially unobtainable specifically 1 day after chrome accepts the update. And fully replaced with the new donation badges.

New stuff
- Added a feature that shows the price floor of the item type you are viewing and if the item you are viewing is at, above or below (even tho that shouldn't be possible LOL) the price floor.
- Added quality of life toggles to the nav bar that allows you to toggle your online status and experience status without going into settings
- Added avatar rotator.
- Added Clear storage to the settings page, used to clear the storage of features.
- Added a site fix for the remove item from cart button being the incorrect size (thank me later Roblox)

Changes
- Attempted to improve the automatic region finding (again), now using a easier to debug system scoring each server based off the distance from you to them, and if it doesn't find the closest server with the RoValra api it will fall back to scanning manually as an attempt to improve it on smaller games. Also added some text for inactive and loadbalancing servers.
- Changed the building of the extension very slightly just making it not minify whitespace.
- Changed the download assets from create page to download meshes as .mesh instead of .obj
- Changed donation links to a new donation link
- Fixed RoValra adding quick genarate and copy private server links to expired private servers.
- Fixed not interested not being clickable on recommended games while quickplay is active
- Fixed oauth not working
- Fixed RoValra modifying help.roblox.com

releases.name: v2.4.7
releases.body:
New stuff
- Added legacy donation badges here for a limited time.
- Added draggable groups. thanks to qBorder
- Added a download button allowing you to download any asset from the create.roblox.com page

Changes
- Fixed globe sorting regions by state and not by city making san jose and los angeles both have the combined total as their servers
- Fixed roseal improved server list breaking recent servers
- Fixed Roblox breaking multiple profile features.
- Changed total servers back to using total servers in the counts api

releases.name: v2.4.6
releases.body:
Changes:
- Removed all uses of auth.roblox.com/v1/logout to get the csrf token
- Fixed the quick play button snapping when added to featured games containers. Thanks to alice for the help.
- Fixed recent servers duplicating when spam clicking refresh.
- Fixed https://github.com/NotValra/RoValra/issues/34
- Updated the quickplay.scss to be readable lol
- Changed quickplay private server name from dompurify to safeHtml since it is better for that use case.
